title: 第13章 药浴准备第14章 借花献佛系统奖励
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
………………
酒杯碰撞声不断传出。
一众长老在一旁相互对饮，后续江文康三人也加入了其中。
众人喝的那叫一个畅快。
……
另一边。
江宇迈步来到江尘近前，冲着他露出了一抹淡淡的微笑。
江宇：“尘弟，我俩喝一杯如何？”
江尘微微点头：“当然没问题。”
话音落下。
江尘便抬起身前酒杯，两兄弟相视一笑之后，同时将杯中之酒全部饮尽。
不得不说。
今天江宇主动透露自身情况，还是让江尘有些意外的，不过效果却是十分不错。
如今的江家正需要一个希望，而江宇天赋恢复，则是众人的一颗定心丸。
不仅稳定了人心，还借助这个机会让族人变得更加团结，可谓是一举两得。
本来江尘还打算做点什么，可随着江宇这么一搞，倒是给他省去了不少麻烦。
想到这。
江尘内心默默给江宇点了一个赞。
……
半刻钟后。

宴会也来到了尾声，不少人先行离开了大殿，毕竟还有很多事等着他们去处理。
过了一会。
江宇也从座位上站了起来。
目光投向了一旁的江尘。
江宇：“二弟，我们也走吧，上次说的东西我都准备好了。”
嗯？？？
随着江宇这一开口，一旁的江尘先是微微一愣，随后当即反应了过来。
江宇说过要帮自己增强体质，本以为还要一些时间，没想到他这么快就准备好了。
明白其中的缘由后。
江尘也没有拒绝。
当即起身准备与他一同离开。
就在这时。
江宇转头看向一旁的江道心。
再次开口：“道心，你一起过去吧。”
嗯？？？
听到有人叫自己名字，埋头吃饭的江道心突然抬起头颅，眼眸中满是疑惑之色。
江道心：“大哥，去哪里啊？俺爹说等会还得训练呢。”
江道心话音刚落，一旁的江文远顿时气不打一处来，直接在他后脑勺上拍了一下。
沉声道：“小兔崽子，你大哥叫你去你就跟着去，说这么多废话干嘛。”
江道心：“爹，今天不训练了吗？”

话音落下。
江道心还不忘咬一口手中的鸡腿。
江文远：“你……”
content_en:
………………
The sound of clinking wine glasses kept coming.
A group of elders drank with each other at the side, and Jiang Wenkang and three others later joined them.
Everyone drank and felt happy.
…
other side.
Jiang Yu stepped up to Jiang Chen and gave him a faint smile.
Jiang Yu: "Brother Chen, how about we have a drink?"
Jiang Chen nodded slightly: "Of course it's no problem."
The words fell.
Jiang Chen raised the wine glass in front of him, and the two brothers looked at each other and drank all the wine at the same time.
I have to say.
Today, Jiang Yu took the initiative to reveal his own situation, which still surprised Jiang Chen, but the effect was very good.
Today's Jiang family is in need of hope, and Jiang Yu's recovery of talent is a reassurance for everyone.
Not only did it stabilize people's hearts, but it also used this opportunity to make the tribe more united, which can be said to kill two birds with one stone.
Originally Jiang Chen planned to do something, but with Jiang Yu doing this, it saved him a lot of trouble.
Think of this.
Jiang Chen silently gave Jiang Yu a thumbs up.
…
Half an hour later.
The banquet also came to an end, and many people left the hall first. After all, there were still many things waiting for them to deal with.
After a while.
Jiang Yu also stood up from his seat.
His eyes turned to Jiang Chen who was standing aside.
Jiang Yu: "Second brother, let's go too. I've prepared everything I mentioned last time."
Huh? ? ?
Following Jiang Yu's words, Jiang Chen on the side was slightly startled for a moment, and then reacted immediately.
Jiang Yu had said that he would help himself strengthen his physique. He thought it would take some time, but he didn't expect that he would be ready so soon.
After understanding the reason.
Jiang Chen did not refuse.
He immediately stood up and prepared to leave with him.
Just then.
Jiang Yu turned to look at Jiang Daoxin who was aside.
He spoke again: "Dao Xin, please go there together."
Huh? ? ?
When he heard someone calling his name, Jiang Daoxin, who was immersed in eating, suddenly raised his head, his eyes full of doubts.
Jiang Daoxin: "Brother, where are you going? My dad said we have to train later."
As soon as Jiang Daoxin finished speaking, Jiang Wenyuan beside him suddenly became furious and slapped him on the back of the head.
He said in a deep voice: "Little bastard, if your elder brother tells you to go, just follow him. Why are you talking so much nonsense?"
Jiang Daoxin: "Dad, aren't you going to train today?"
The words fell.
Jiang Daoxin didn't forget to take a bite of the chicken leg in his hand.
Jiang Wenyuan: "You..."
